summary: The comment highlights the importance of E-Rate funding for libraries in WV, emphasizing the impact on patrons who rely on the library for network access for school and work.

claims.argument: Without E-Rate funding, libraries would not be able to afford high-speed internet, affecting patrons who rely on the library for network access.
claims.evidence_quote: Without E-Rate our library would not be able to afford high speed internet which will affect patrons who rely on the library for network access for school and for work.
